targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ts as time,
  (sum(heap_blks_read+heap_blks_hit+idx_blks_read+idx_blks_hit)-lag(sum(heap_blks_read+heap_blks_hit+idx_blks_read+idx_blks_hit)) over (order by ts))/600 as value
FROM pgstatspack_snap s, pgstatspack_tables t
WHERE ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
   AND s.snapid=t.snapid
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts ASC

SELECT
  ts as time,
  sum(count_star) as value,
  case when working then 'Active' else '<IDLE>' end as metric
FROM pgstatspack_snap s, pgstatspack_activity_v a
WHERE ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
   AND s.snapid=a.snapid
GROUP BY working, ts
ORDER BY ts ASC, 2 desc

select ts as time,
       sum(sizek)*1024 as Size 
  from pgstatspack_space_usage
 WHERE ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
 group by ts
 order by ts

SELECT ts as time,
       sum(t.heap_blks_hit)/sum(t.heap_blks_hit+t.heap_blks_read)*100 as value 
  FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
 WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
   AND ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
 group by s.ts
 order by ts

SELECT ts as time,
       sum(t.idx_blks_hit)/sum(t.idx_blks_hit+t.idx_blks_read)*100 as value 
  FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
 WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
   AND ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
 group by s.ts
 order by s.ts

select $__timeEpoch(ts),
       'Read' as metric,
       greatest(val-lag(val) over (order by ts), 0) as value
  from (SELECT ts, sum(t.seq_tup_read) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
         WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
         GROUP BY s.ts) sum_read
 where ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
UNION
select $__timeEpoch(ts),
       'Fetch' as metric,
       greatest(val-lag(val) over (order by ts), 0) as value
  from (SELECT ts, sum(t.idx_tup_fetch) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
         WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
         GROUP BY s.ts) sum_read
 where ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
 order by 1 asc, 2 desc

select ts as time,
       'Commit' as metric,
       greatest(val-lag(val) over (order by ts), 0) as value
  from (SELECT ts, sum(d.xact_commit) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_database d, pgstatspack_snap s
         WHERE d.snapid=s.snapid
         GROUP BY s.ts) sum_comm
 where ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
UNION
select ts as time,
       'Rollback' as metric,
       greatest(val-lag(val) over (order by ts), 0) as value
  from (SELECT ts, sum(d.xact_rollback) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_database d, pgstatspack_snap s
         WHERE d.snapid=s.snapid
         GROUP BY s.ts) sum_comm
 where ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
 order by 1 asc, 2 desc

SELECT ts as time,
       sum(t.toast_blks_hit)/sum(t.toast_blks_hit+t.toast_blks_read)*100 as value 
  FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
 WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
   AND ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
 group by s.ts
 having sum(t.toast_blks_hit+t.toast_blks_read)>0
 order by s.ts

select ts as time,
       'Inserted' as metric,
       greatest(val-lag(val) over (order by ts), 0) as value
  from (SELECT ts, sum(t.n_tup_ins) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
         WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
           and ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
         GROUP BY s.ts) sum_read
UNION
select ts as time,
       'Updated' as metric,
       greatest(val-lag(val) over (order by ts), 0) as value
  from (SELECT ts, sum(t.n_tup_upd) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
         WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
           AND ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
         GROUP BY s.ts) sum_read
UNION
select ts as time,
       'Deleted' as metric,
       -greatest(val-lag(val) over (order by ts), 0) as value
  from (SELECT ts, sum(t.n_tup_del) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
         WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
           AND ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
         GROUP BY s.ts) sum_read
 order by 1 asc, 2 desc

SELECT
  floor(extract(epoch from timest)/86400)*86400 as "time",
  max(to_char(timest,' HH24')) as metric,
  sum(val) as value
FROM (SELECT ts as timest, sum(case working when true then 1 else 0 end) as val
          FROM pgstatspack_snap s, pgstatspack_activity_v a
         WHERE ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
           AND s.snapid=a.snapid
         GROUP BY ts ) q
GROUP BY floor(extract(epoch from timest)/3600)*3600,floor(extract(epoch from timest)/86400)*86400
ORDER BY floor(extract(epoch from timest)/3600)*3600,floor(extract(epoch from timest)/86400)*86400;

SELECT ts as time,
       sum(t.tidx_blks_hit)/sum(t.tidx_blks_hit+t.tidx_blks_read)*100 as value 
  FROM pgstatspack_tables t, pgstatspack_snap s
 WHERE t.snapid=s.snapid
   AND ts between to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) and to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
 group by s.ts
 having sum(t.tidx_blks_hit+t.tidx_blks_read)>0
 order by s.ts

SELECT now() as time,
       count(*) as value 
  FROM pg_stat_replication s
 group by now()
